audit.whatIsWrong: Every chart row disagreed across layers. phases sides read Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Yone/Skill/Yone against win[] of LeBlanc x5, Yone, LeBlanc.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is identical to the content win[] array, so the full-layer sides are the stale copy — and the page renders both.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side aligned to the packet as one atomic group; phases[5].why rewritten so the First-item sentence agrees with the Yone verdict it now sits under.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game text claimed Yone can get 'a free R reset off a side-kill'.
audit.why: Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s with no reset condition anywhere in Riot's text. Building the late-game plan around a reset that does not exist is a fabricated spike.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real threat: Fate Sealed's 1000 range, the blink behind the last champion in a line, and the pull on everyone hit.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound was described as a dash five separate times ('his E dash', 'bait the E dash', 'double-dash back'), and Fate Sealed was called a knock-up.
audit.why: Soul Unbound leaves Yone's body behind and grants move speed to the spirit — no dash flag, and the body is a stationary target for its whole duration, which is the actual thing you punish. His real gap-closer is Mortal Steel's second stack (Q, 4s), which is also the only knock-up in the kit. Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls enemies toward him — a pull, not an airborne. And Spirit Cleave (W, 14s) shields him scaling with champions hit, which is what actually eats your burst window and was never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Dash/knock-up claims replaced throughout; the Spirit Cleave shield now appears in breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[0] and enemyWin.

audit.why: Soul Unbound halves from 22s to 10s across its ranks — the entire punish window shrinks as the lane goes on, and the page never said so.
audit.corrected: Rewritten with 22s/10s, Spirit Cleave 14s, Fate Sealed 120s.

edits.before: First item spike: Q-W-RW deletes squishies. Spend the lane lead before scaling lanes wake.
edits.after: His first crit item lands and Spirit Cleave shields on 14s. Poke, return, and refuse the second exchange.

edits.before: - Yone Soul Unbound: matchup-defining — His burst window — survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Distortion (return) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Soul Unbound (E): 22s at rank 1, 10s at rank 5 — his spirit leaves the body behind, so survive it and punish the body he snaps back to. - Spirit Cleave (W) is 14s and shields him for every champion it hits. - Fate Sealed (R) is 120s at rank 1.

edits.before: Q the sigil, W the detonation, return before the answer — a half-bar round trip he experienced as weather.
edits.after: His closer is Mortal Steel's second stack on 4s — chain him as the gust lands, not while he charges it.

edits.before: Yone whiffs Soul Unbound and the lane briefly belongs to you.
edits.after: Mimic a second Distortion and you get to leave twice — that is your out.

edits.before: That is Yone’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: Spirit Cleave shields on 14s and grows per champion hit — your burst maths lie.

edits.before: Staying at the W landing spot for one more auto — the return timer is your champion; outliving it is optional.
edits.after: Every second auto is bonus magic damage and Spirit Cleave shields on 14s — melee is the range he was built for.

edits.before: Yone wins by landing Soul Unbound, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Yone wins by shielding your burst with Spirit Cleave, closing on Mortal Steel, and pulling you back with Fate Sealed.

edits.before: Carry through picks — one chained carry per objective; your job is the flank angle and the discipline to leave after.
edits.after: Carry through picks — chain him the moment his spirit snaps back; Soul Unbound is 22s at rank 1 and the shield is spent.

edits.before: If Yone takes first blood, tighten up: Soul Unbound is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with W clears and stay relevant through chain picks.
edits.after: If Yone takes first blood, stop trading inside 450 range — Mortal Steel is 4 seconds and his shield is 14. A second kill means the duel is over and the game is not: W-clear, and take your picks off-lane.

edits.before: Bait-and-punish on his E dash defines level 3, letting you land full combos while he's exposed mid-animation
edits.after: Bait-and-punish Soul Unbound defines level 3 — it is 16s at rank 3, and it is no dash, so he cannot leave your combo

edits.before: Yone's level 6 all-in with R knock-up into crit autos out-damages your single-rotation burst if he catches you off cooldown
edits.after: Yone's level 6 all-in with Fate Sealed pulling you back into crit autos out-damages your single-rotation burst if he catches you

edits.before: Chain W-Distortion into Q-Sigil and E-Ethereal Chains the instant Yone commits E-Soul Unbound forward; he has no dash to close the gap after his blade returns, so you punish the recall with full combo and walk away.
edits.after: Chain W-Distortion into Q-Sigil and E-Ethereal Chains the instant Yone sends Soul Unbound forward; the spirit is no dash and the body stays put, so punish the body he snaps back to and leave inside its 22-second window.

edits.before: Yone hits 6 with a genuine all-in via R-Fate Sealed knock-up into full auto-crit follow-up; you have to respect flash-R range and not facecheck a trading window.
edits.after: Yone hits 6 with a genuine all-in: Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in a line and pulls everyone it hits toward him, so never stand strung out behind a wave he can cut through at 1000 range.

edits.before: Your burst chunks him from range through fog before he can flash-in with double-dash mobility, but if he ever gets a free R reset off a side-kill your kiting window disappears fast.
edits.after: Your burst chunks him from range through fog before he can close on Mortal Steel, but Fate Sealed reaches 1000 and drags everyone in its line, so never stack up behind a target he can cut through.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 stay yours: bait the E dash, land your full combo the second he's grounded on your side, then reset with W before he can double-dash back with the return cast. At level 6 the fight briefly swings his way — his R-Fate Sealed knock-up chains into a full crit auto sequence that outdamages your one combo if he catches you without Distortion up, so you need to play around his ult timer rather than greedily trading.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 stay yours: bait Soul Unbound, land your full combo on the body he leaves behind, then reset with W before the spirit snaps home. At level 6 the fight briefly swings his way — Fate Sealed blinks behind the last champion in the line and drags everyone hit back to him, chaining into crit autos that outdamage your one combo, so play around a 120-second ult timer rather than trading greedily.

edits.before: Once you're two items deep (Lost Chapter/Shadow Flame into Luden's or Cryptbloom) your burst from max range outpaces anything Yone can do without a free dash-in, letting you poke him out of teamfights before he ever gets to auto you. Ban his R engage on you specifically in skirmishes — if he flashes in on a side-target and resets his ultimate, he becomes nearly impossible to peel for.
edits.after: Once you're two items deep (Lost Chapter/Shadowflame into Luden's or Cryptbloom) your burst from max range outpaces anything Yone can do without closing on Mortal Steel, letting you poke him out of teamfights before he ever gets to auto you. Stand off the line in skirmishes — Fate Sealed reaches 1000 and pulls every champion it clips, so the safe spot is not directly behind your frontline.

edits.before: Hold W-Distortion as an escape until he's used his dash
edits.after: Hold W-Distortion until Mortal Steel's knockup is spent

edits.before: Land E through minions to close distance safely
edits.after: Send Soul Unbound in without risking his body
